title: reliquary blueprint
description: Synchronized companion to the composed blueprint model (planning/design/blueprint-model.md), which remains normative. One authored JSON kind, .rlqb, holding named components (machine/media/source/archive) in plural sections, or a bare-root lone machine. Schema validity never implies document validity: names default to the source/path stem, the materialize/source/size coupling, sha256-required-on-url, medium compatibility, (name,type) uniqueness, and every reference resolution and backend capability check live in the specification and the parser only. It validates the parsed document; the JSONC dialect (comments, trailing commas) is invisible at this level. Documents carry no $schema field pre-1.0; editors bind this schema to *.rlqb by file association. The machine state (machine.json) is a separate document type with its own schema (machine-state.schema.json).

document.description: The sectioned form: any combination of the plural component sections, each a list. A bare-root machine (no section keys) is the other form.

machine.description: Machine topology only. A drive names a media or is empty; content and materialization live on the media. name is optional here (a bare-root machine takes the file stem; a machine in a machines[] list must name itself — a rule beyond this schema).

platform.description: The guest platform. Required; never inferred.

backend.description: The virtualization backend. Omitted, assigned at materialization; declared, it pins the choice.

memory.description: Guest memory: a positive integer (MiB) or a size string.

drives.description: The drive inventory. Keys declare medium and slot; each value names a media (string), is null for an empty removable slot, or is an object naming a media plus hardware attributes. size/base/hostdir are gone from the drive — they are the media's business.

boot.description: Boot order: declared drive keys tried in order, unique by slot.

scripts.description: Short labels naming .rlqs script stems; the verbs used with run-script.

parameters.description: Blueprint-supplied answers for script-declared properties: a direct string value or a {"property": "<key>"} redirect.

media.description: A media component: owns content and materialization. materialize is new (a size, no source), difference/copy (a source materialized into the drive's own image), or use (the source attached directly; default). sha256 verifies the payload and is required when the resolved source is a url (a rule beyond this schema). read-only defaults true on a cdrom. hostdir is a directory source with materialize use. The materialize/source/size coupling is enforced by the parser.

extension.description: Override the type-declaring extension of the cached payload when the source filename misnames it.

source.description: A named standalone locator (the sources section): the same locator schema given its own name, so it can be supplied or replaced independently of the media that pins the payload hash. Exactly one of url, local, or a from-archive reference.

archive.description: A named container: a source (where the archive bytes are) plus recursive members. A member with its own members is an archive to descend into; a leaf member is a media payload. sha256 verifies the archive, required when its source is a url (a rule beyond this schema).

member.description: One node in an archive tree. path is the member's location inside the parent archive. With members it is a nested archive; without, it is a leaf media (and may carry any media field but source, which the tree supplies).

locator.description: Where bytes come from: a string naming a source or archive component, or an inline object (url / local / from-archive).

removableDrive.description: A floppy or cdrom slot: a media name (string), null (empty slot), or an object naming a media plus hardware attributes.

fixedDrive.description: A hard-disk slot: a media name (string) or an object. Fixed drives cannot be empty (no null).

enabled.description: false removes the drive from the machine entirely while keeping the entry in the document.

componentName.description: A component's name, or a by-name reference to one. Grammar deliberately open pre-asset-spec; the stem-default and (name,type) uniqueness rules live in the parser.

url.description: A single URL, or a list of mirror alternates for the identical artifact (the sha256 is the arbiter).

sizeString.description: A positive integer immediately followed by a binary unit suffix K, M, G, or T (powers of 1024), case-insensitive.

controller.description: The kind of storage controller the drive attaches to. Default ide.
